Tests that colors are not re-formatted inside url(...) when editing property values.

white
url( white )
url(white.png)
url(../foo/white.png)
green url(white)
url(white) green
url(white) green, url(green)
url(white), url(green)
hsl(0, 50%, 50%) url(white)
url(white) hsl(0, 50%, 50%)
url(../black/white.png)
